decisionModel: A successful attested-payload delivery requires a distinct signed PayloadAttestationRecord, a passing exact-byte method proof, and matching listing/agreement/settlement bindings. Resolved contradictions fail; unavailable otherwise-valid evidence remains indeterminate.
hashRecipe: sha256(compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of vectors)

vectors.name: dahr-payload-bound-success
vectors.reason: finalized DAHR request/response commitment binds the exact UTF-8 payload and commerce tuple

vectors.name: explicit-self-signed-tier-still-carries-proof

payloadAttestationRecord.reason: explicit minimal-trust self-signed payload proof verified

vectors.reason: self-signed is permitted only as an explicit minimal-trust method with a payload-bound proof

vectors.name: listing-method-missing-rejected-before-payment
vectors.reason: DPA-1 rejects an unfulfillable listing before any payment

vectors.name: seller-settlement-signature-cannot-substitute
vectors.reason: success evidence without attestationRef is seller/orchestrator self-assertion, not attested delivery

vectors.name: verifyresult-discriminator-cannot-coerce
vectors.reason: DPA-9 refuses a claim VerifyResult shape as a payload attestation

vectors.name: unsupported-payload-attestation-version
vectors.reason: unknown structural discriminator is refused before field interpretation

vectors.name: payload-record-signature-invalid
vectors.reason: record signature must verify under the payload-attestation domain

vectors.name: settlement-domain-signature-replay-rejected
vectors.reason: a valid signature under dacs-evidence:v1 cannot authenticate the payload record

vectors.name: record-job-mismatch
vectors.reason: payload record jobId must equal the agreement and SettlementEvidence jobId

vectors.name: record-agreement-mismatch
vectors.reason: proof from another committed agreement cannot be reused

vectors.name: record-deliverable-spec-mismatch
vectors.reason: record must bind the exact signed-listing DeliverableSpec

vectors.name: record-payload-digest-mismatch
vectors.reason: method proof, record, delivered bytes, and SettlementEvidence must share one digest

vectors.name: record-method-mismatch
vectors.reason: method substitution is detected against the signed listing

vectors.name: method-evidence-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: resolved native evidence must match its AttestationRef

vectors.name: method-evidence-unresolvable
vectors.reason: non-observation is not a clean negative and cannot produce success

vectors.name: dahr-transaction-reference-missing
vectors.reason: generic SDK optionality does not permit a DAHR-backed pass without txHash

vectors.name: dahr-transaction-not-authenticated
vectors.reason: broadcast/RPC acknowledgement is not consensus evidence

vectors.name: dahr-request-does-not-match-method
vectors.reason: DAHR request URL and method must match the signed verificationMethod

vectors.name: dahr-response-bytes-do-not-match-commitment
vectors.reason: delivered UTF-8 bytes must hash to DAHR responseHash

vectors.name: nonpass-payload-record-cannot-support-success
vectors.reason: DPA-5 never collapses indeterminate to pass

vectors.name: settlement-reference-does-not-match-record
vectors.reason: SettlementEvidence must reference the exact signed payload record

vectors.name: cross-session-record-replay
vectors.reason: a valid record from one job cannot support another job
